name: Rain-Soaked Crowd (5-6)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-04: An Enkindled Carnival

disable: DC 21 Diplomacy check (trained) to calm them down, DC 22 Intimidation check (trained) to cow them, DC 24 Athletics check (trained) to force them back

items.name: Surge Forward
items.text:
Trigger The PCs fail to overcome a task during the Dreaded Downpour event

---
Effect The crowd surges forward, dealing 4d8+10 bludgeoning damage to each PC. Each affected creature must attempt a DC 21 Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and takes a –1 circumstance penalty to their next skill check to overcome a task during the Dreaded Downpour event.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their next skill check to overcome a task during the Dreaded Downpour event.

text: A crowd of carnival goers are spurred to panic by supernatural rain.
